$comment: Illustrative partner-engagement obligation manifest — the CONTAINER shape. The envelope carries engagement metadata; every element of obligations[] is a kye.engagement.obligation.v1 row, referenced (never redefined) by the container schema.

obligations.clause: Partner shall execute and uphold the KYE Mutual NDA covering all non-public materials, customer data, roadmap disclosures, and pre-release SDK access shared during the engagement.
Partner shall re-certify each named delivery engineer against the current KYE Conformance Pack release and submit the passing conformance run as evidence once every twelve months.
